div.head: II Eg 2.2
div.ab: ⁊ ga ælc cyricsceat into þam ealdan mynstre be ælcum frigan eorðe.
⁊ gá ælc cyricsceat into þam ealdan mynstre be ælcom frigean heorþe.
Et eat omne cyricsceattum ad matrem ecclesiam de omni libera domo.
⁊ ga ælc ciricsceat into ðam ealdan mynstre be ælcum frigan heorðe.
And ga ælc cyricsceat into þam ealdan mynstre be ælcum frigan eorðe.
And every church-due for every free household shall go to the old church.
And all Church dues from every free household are to go to the old minster.
And all church-scot is to go to the old minster, from every free hearth.
Und jede Kirchensteuer von jedem freien Herde gehe in die alte Pfarrkirche.
And let every church-scot from every free hearth go to the old minster.
div.note: VII Atr 4; VII Atr 4.1; Cn 1027 16; I Cn 11.2

note.label: cites
note.quote: Edgar's Andover code ordered that church-scot be paid to the 'old minster', going on to cite Ine's law on Martinmas payment and the sanction for default

note.label: first mentioned in
note.quote: This is first mentioned in Ine 4, with heavy penalties for non-payment.

div.note: This is first mentioned in Ine 4, with heavy penalties for non-payment. It was paid by free men in proportion to their holding, usually in grain.
